what.text: This page follows people displaced inside India, as estimated by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 529671 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
UNHCR's data has no figure for people displaced inside India.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory with Kashmir insurgents from 2003 to 2025, at war level from 2003 to 2005.
It also records armed conflict over the government with the MCC, the PWG and the CPI-Maoist from 2003 to 2025, and conflicts over Assam and Bodoland territory in some of those years.
Floods, storms, erosion and mass movements are the disasters recorded for India in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure peaked at 1000000 in 2012 and fell to 469624 by 2019.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2017, 2021 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC recorded 672101 new displacements from disasters, counted separately from conflict.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside India people moved to.
